primary_interest.quote: We want a voice AI support agent that handles inbound patient calls

use_case.quote: We want a voice AI support agent that handles inbound patient calls: appointment changes, directions, billing questions

inference_framing.quote: A voice agent needs a language model behind it to understand and respond, so our Voice AI agent uses our hosted inference API for that.

inference_raised_by.quote: A voice agent needs a language model behind it to understand and respond, so our Voice AI agent uses our hosted inference API for that.
